subject: English
question_text: Write a summary of the above passage in your own words.
guide_solution: George Washington, the first President of the USA, was born in 1732 in Virginia. He was the commander-in- chief of the continental army during the American Revolutionary war and one of the Founding Fathers of the United States. However, the members of his family were tobacco cultivators. They used to cultivate tobacco in their estates in Virginia. At the age of 20 George Washington took over these estates and started living a comfortable life.
